unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U01: Distinguish free consent,void/voidable effects and banking relationships

payload.title: The remedy depends on the defect and the transaction
payload.core_explanation_md:
Free consent requires more than a signature. Coercion, undue influence, fraud, misrepresentation and the relevant mistake rules can have different legal effects. Void and voidable should not be used interchangeably:the latter involves the stated party option and applicable relief, not automatic enforceability for everyone.

Bank-customer roles also depend on the transaction. An ordinary deposit creates a debtor-creditor relationship with the bank as debtor; an advance reverses the basic debt positions. Collection work can involve agency, and delivered safe-custody goods can involve bailment. Do not classify every bank service as a trust or decide locker liability from an old shorthand label alone.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every bank-customer interaction create the same legal relationship?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the particular service and its legal incidents.

payload.stem_md: An ordinary account deposit is described as requiring return of the same physical currency notes as a bailment. What distinction matters?

options.text_md: Ordinary deposit debt differs from bailment of identified goods
Every deposit is a sale of the customer property to a third party
options.explanation_md: That is not the stated ordinary relationship.

options.text_md: Bank custody always creates identical duties for every service
options.explanation_md: Different services have different legal incidents.

options.text_md: A bank can ignore the deposit obligation
options.explanation_md: The debt relationship still carries obligations.

payload.stem_md: A consent defect is identified, but a note calls void and voidable identical without checking the remedy. What is required?

options.text_md: Treat every defect as automatic full enforcement
options.explanation_md: Effects depend on the applicable rule.

options.text_md: Apply the particular consent rule and its legal consequences
options.explanation_md: The labels describe different enforceability effects.

options.text_md: Replace the original facts with a new signature
options.explanation_md: A later act does not automatically resolve the prior defect.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The labels describe different enforceability effects.
